source: Ticket 775 (spec #774), the GD lock of 23 Oct 2026 on Campaign Scaling: the four size classes S/M/L/XL at x0.9/1.0/1.1/1.2 of an SS1 planet's radius at the same time target, on a base of about 25 minutes, so the targets are 22.5/25/27.5/30 (VS and Systems, 23 Oct).
